name: point-talk
prompt: Create a TALKING-WHILE-POINTING sprite animation atlas matching the EXACT approved mascot from the references. The SECOND reference shows the pointing direction: use its FINAL fully extended pointing pose for EVERY frame, never its neutral starting poses. This is the same boy, same face, navy gold-arrow cap, burgundy waistcoat, cream sleeves, steel center buckle and toolbelt. Same hand-painted polished cartoon style. Eight complete waist-up WHOLE ACTORS in FOUR COLUMNS TWO ROWS on transparent. All8 already holding the index-finger pointing pose UP RIGHT, eyes and raised chin look up-right. Head, pupils, hand, extended arm, torso, clothes and belt must remain precisely STILL and IDENTICAL between all8; ONLY mouth and tiny cheek expression vary for speaking. Frame0 mouth CLOSED,1 small open,2 small A,3 narrow E,4 small O,5 small A,6 gently closing,7 CLOSED. No large open grin, no body shaking. Keep central horizontal silver buckle completely visible. Draw actors modestly sized, maximum silhouette330px wide INCLUDING arm and roughly280–320px tall inside each cell, with large clear gutters at least40px between complete actors. No touching edges, no clipped elbow/fingertip/hat, no text, borders, effect, labels or unrelated actors. Each frame contains full character; no separate mouth/limbs. Same camera scale all8 and the identity/proportions of the approved reference.
